findings.current:
could be described in just four words:

A back-and-forth struggle.
findings.defect: The source says four characters, not four words.
findings.rationale: 일진일퇴 is a four-character expression for the battle’s back-and-forth course.
findings.replacement:
could be summed up in four characters:

Advance and retreat.
findings.source:
단 네 글자로 설명할 수 있었다.

일진일퇴(一進一退).

findings.current: But the comrade who had saved his life countless times never answered.
findings.defect: The draft turns repeated mutual rescues into one comrade repeatedly saving the other.
findings.rationale: 서로의 목숨을 구해 준 makes the rescues reciprocal.
findings.replacement: But the comrade with whom he had saved each other’s life time and again never answered.
findings.source: 지금껏 몇 번이나 서로의 목숨을 구해 준 전우는 대답하지 않았다.

findings.current: A war of attrition, made possible by their more-than-tenfold numbers.
findings.defect: A war of attrition loses the specific tactic of rotating fighters against the enemy.
findings.rationale: 차륜전 describes successive, rotating attacks, not merely wearing an opponent down.
findings.replacement: They used their more-than-tenfold numbers to attack in rotating waves.
findings.source: 열 배가 넘는 머릿수를 바탕으로 펼치는 차륜전.

findings.current: dazzling flashes cut through the air and shot toward the Skeleton King.
findings.defect: The flashes cut through the falling bodies, not the air.
findings.rationale: 시신을 가르며 identifies the bodies as what the flashes cut through.
findings.replacement: dazzling flashes cut through the falling bodies and shot toward the Skeleton King.
findings.source: 눈부신 섬광이 시신을 가르며 스켈레톤 킹을 향해 날아들었다.

findings.current: “Which one of us is the demon?”
findings.defect: The Skeleton King is objecting to being called a demon, rather than asking which of the two is one.
findings.rationale: 누가 악마라는 거냐 is a direct retort to the fanatic’s “이 악마야!”

findings.current: He muttered a string of curses as his blond hair fluttered, then faced forward.
findings.defect: The draft omits that he looks at the blond hair and assumes it is his.
findings.rationale: 흩날리는 금발을 보며 states what he sees but does not explicitly identify whose hair it is.
findings.replacement: He watched blond hair flutter through the air, muttered a string of curses, then faced forward.
findings.source: 흩날리는 금발을 보며 쌍욕을 중얼거린 그가 정면을 응시했다.

summary: Several action and tactical details are altered, including a mutual bond between comrades and how the fanatics use their numbers.
